headline: Colombia peso trades near official representative market rate of 3,182.99
summary: The official representative market rate for the Colombian peso stood at 3,182.99 per US dollar, with analysts projecting possible movement toward 3,250.
why: Exchange rate movements in emerging market currencies affect import bills, inflation pass-through, and foreign currency debt servicing costs.
